import os,json,urllib.request,hashlib,subprocess,stat
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal')
release=root/'releases/0a1a4c190a7d33752d6dc3f4418ed44735c8a7dd'
sha='e443b2161f88fd9228335f3d681ee52858a78d48'
url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/martaxi-boss/skill-universal/'+sha+'/install/vps-android-cli-isolated.sh'
res={'mode':'Ferrari-only Android Linux CLI installation','status':'BLOCKED'}
try:
 assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink() and release.is_dir()
 assert (root/'runtimes/jdk-25.0.5_8/bin/java').is_file()
 assert Path('/srv/projects/android-sdk').is_dir()
 data=urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=22).read(16000)
 assert data.startswith(b'#!/usr/bin/env bash') and b'FERRARI_ANDROID_NO_GLOBAL_INSTALL=PASS' in data
 dest=release/'install/vps-android-cli-isolated.sh'
 assert not dest.is_symlink() and (not dest.exists() or dest.read_bytes()==data)
 dest.write_bytes(data);dest.chmod(0o750)
 v=subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',str(dest)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=145)
 res.update({'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'installer_exit':v.returncode,'installer_stdout':v.stdout[-2200:],'installer_stderr':v.stderr[-2200:],'status':'INSTALLED' if v.returncode==0 else 'FAILED'})
except Exception as e:res['error']=type(e).__name__+':'+str(e)[:180]
print(json.dumps(res))
